_comment: SWEG_ANTITANK_ADVANCE_DISCIPLINE — the narrow, faction-neutral cousin of the retired generic SWEG_ADVANCE_DISCIPLINE gate and of the per-faction gunline-hold family (simulator.am_advance_discipline / simulator.ck_ranged_hold / simulator.votann_ranged_hold). An artificial-intelligence piloting heuristic, not a 10e rules claim: it grounds in the core-rules fact that Advancing forfeits non-[ASSAULT] shooting (quoted below), and is registered so the citation auditor tracks it. Default-off, byte-identical off.

simulator.antitank_advance_discipline.rule_name: Advancing (10e Core Rules, Movement phase) + [ASSAULT] weapon ability — anti-tank shot-preservation piloting heuristic
simulator.antitank_advance_discipline.quoted_text: A unit that Advances can't shoot or declare a charge later this turn. ... [ASSAULT]: If a unit made a Normal move, Advanced or Fell Back this turn, its models can still make ranged attacks with weapons they are equipped with that have the [ASSAULT] ability when this unit is selected to shoot.
simulator.antitank_advance_discipline.trigger: SWEG_ANTITANK_ADVANCE_DISCIPLINE=1 (default-off; unset is the byte-identical kill-switch); a moving unit carrying no [ASSAULT] weapon (and no transient [ASSAULT] grant this round) that has at least one enemy unit within its weapon's current range (measured from the attacker's position before this turn's move) which is a durable 'brick' target (Toughness 10 or higher, or 15 or more starting Wounds) it can meaningfully damage (expected unsaved wounds this phase, via the same _ranged_expected_wounds collective-crack math the focus-fire layer uses, of at least 1.0)
simulator.antitank_advance_discipline.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a 10e rules claim; grounds in the core-rules fact quoted above that a unit which Advances forfeits its entire Shooting phase (non-[ASSAULT] weapons cannot fire). The capstone activation-allocation decomposition (waterfall instrument, N=12+12 paired, docs/DECISION_LEDGER.md 'THE FINAL DECOMPOSITION' entry, 2026-07-03) found that of 77.4 theoretical expected wounds per game the field's anti-tank output could inflict on Knights, only 11.4 percent is ever actually pointed at one; of the 25.4 percent SUPPRESSED share, 31 percent is exactly this mis-pilot — the artificial intelligence Advancing an anti-tank unit that had a live shot on a durable in-range target, forfeiting the shot for nothing (Necrons alone contribute 51 percent of that suppressed share; units that had already Fallen Back contribute 13 percent). Unlike the retired generic SWEG_ADVANCE_DISCIPLINE (screened metric-harmful, +2.19, because it held every shooter regardless of target) and unlike the per-faction gunline-hold levers (which hold a qualifying gunline heading for an objective whenever ANY enemy sits within reach of a Normal move), this lever's narrowness lives entirely in the TARGET, not the army or the intent: it fires only when a real anti-brick shot exists RIGHT NOW, at the unit's current position, so it is faction-neutral by construction and never holds a unit back merely to protect an objective push. Implemented as a second entry point ('_ad_antitank') on the shared _suppress_advance block in code/simulator.py _do_move, downstream of the per-faction entry points and upstream of the per-squad Advance roll, sharing the same non-[ASSAULT] / no-transient-[ASSAULT] exclusion the rest of the family already honours. Off path (SWEG_ANTITANK_ADVANCE_DISCIPLINE unset or '0') byte-identical: confirmed by scripts/sim_motion_proof.py returning an identical sha256 fingerprint before and after the change.
